title: Mek'ele Airport
summary: Mek'ele Airport is a crowded airport located in Mek'ele, Ethiopia.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
The plane with [[Dante Vale]], [[Zhalia Moon]], [[Lok Lambert]], [[Sophie Casterwill]] and [[Cherit]] landed at Mek'ele Airport, as well as the plane with [[the Professor]], [[Rassimov]] and some [[Suits]]. [[Otto]], an old friend of Zhalia's, came to pick up the Huntik team and soon after, the Professor used the [[Ring]] of [[Araknos]] to take control of a taxi driver and follow Otto's car, leaving Rassimov and the Suits behind. {{source|The Golden Asp}}

full_text:
Mek'ele Airport is a crowded airport located in Mek'ele, Ethiopia. 

==History==
The plane with Dante Vale, Zhalia Moon, Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill and Cherit landed at Mek'ele Airport, as well as the plane with the Professor, Rassimov and some Suits. Otto, an old friend of Zhalia's, came to pick up the Huntik team and soon after, the Professor used the Ring of Araknos to take control of a taxi driver and follow Otto's car, leaving Rassimov and the Suits behind. [The Golden Asp]
